author: shahmi
body:
Player Report: Gummi3
Why: Every time he gets temp banned he goes to some mod that probably likes him or is biased just unbans him. 
For example he got temp banned for being racist and saying "ni**er" in chat.
And then he gets banned, and he goes to a mod that won't be named and he is like that's stupid you just have excessive infractions let me just unban you.
Gummi3 has gotten temp banned for atleast over a month TWICE LAST WEEK and then he just goes to a mod that either likes him or is just biased and he gets unbanned!

#BANGUMMI3FORGOOD

replies.author: Iron
replies.body: Gummi3 has been banned for some quite ludicrous reasons. There was no evidence that suggested infractions that would have led to his banning. Although he does have a large amount of infractions, the ones that send him over the cap are not legitimate. Also, a majority of his infractions are on private scrim servers, where, leniency is encouraged.
